item.title: 'They are striking everywhere' - Paramedics in Lebanon speak to BBC after Israeli strikes
item.summary: BBC Middle East correspondent Hugo Bachega joins paramedics on duty in Nabatieh - a city that was once vibrant, but is now abandoned.

item.title: Sixteen injured after ex-student opens fire at high school in Turkey
item.summary: Students and teachers are among those who were injured in the attack in the country's south-east.

item.title: Iran carried out highest number of executions in decades
item.summary: Organisations warn many more people could be executed in the wake of the anti-government protests which swept Iran earlier this year.

item.title: Hungary's next PM would pick up if Putin calls and tell him to stop Ukraine war
item.summary: Russia has offered "pragmatic" relations, but Péter Magyar says he will not call Vladimir Putin himself.

item.title: Peru election drags into second day after ballot delivery fiasco
item.summary: Technical and logistical problems mean Peruvians choosing a new president and members of Congress continue to vote on Monday.

item.title: Police officers among seven arrested over deadly Haiti stampede
item.summary: An investigation is under way into what led to the deaths of 25 people at Laferrière Citadel on Saturday.

item.title: Lebanon seeks peace, but Hezbollah needs to be convinced first
item.summary: The Lebanese government go into peace talks with limited influence over the group.

item.title: Hospital at centre of child HIV outbreak caught reusing syringes in undercover filming
item.summary: Footage shows staff in Pakistan injecting without gloves and reusing syringes, but the hospital boss refuses to acknowledge it is genuine.

item.title: French woman, 86, held by ICE after moving to US to reunite with long-lost love
item.summary: The son of pensioner Marie-Thérèse told French media he is worried for his mother's frail health as she is detained in a Louisiana ICE centre.

item.title: South Korea jails 90-year-old woman for laundering son's drug money
item.summary: The woman has been sentenced to a year in jail for laundering money for her son who is imprisoned in Cambodia.
